exercises.q: Я хочу просто заползти в ___ (норка) и умереть.
exercises.prompt: I just want to crawl into a hole and die.
exercises.why: Some feminine nouns with stressed endings in the nominative case have the stress on the 1st syllable in the accusative: **доска** — **до́ску**, **стена** — **сте́ну**, **рука** — **ру́ку**, **гора** — **го́ру**. — † Human beings and animals.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Some feminine nouns with stressed endings in the nominative case have the stress on the 1st syllable in the accusative: **доска** — **до́ску**, **стена** — **сте́ну**, **рука** — **ру́ку**, **гора** — **го́ру**.

exercises.q: Мы здесь во ___ (имя) Иисуса Христа и короля Карла.
exercises.prompt: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
exercises.why: The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions **кого?** — whom? (to see, to know, to remember, etc.) or **что?** — what? (to see, to read, etc.): *Я вижу девушку. (Кого я вижу?) Я читаю книгу. (Что я читаю?)* — † Human beings and animals.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions **кого?** — whom?
